verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation on how Shortcut performs at tens of thousands of stories, and none on whether workspace or item caps apply. The only nearby items are a generic marketing line about 'quick load times' and user-configured WIP story limits per workflow state. WIP limits are an adjacent feature, not a platform item cap or a scale-performance disclosure, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
